briefing: It was a strong risk-on day: the NASDAQ rose 2.1% and the S&P 500 rose 1.4%, led by semiconductors, AI hardware and crypto-linked names. We are keeping all seven current positions and putting the small remaining cash into EQPT, one of the few top-scoring candidates that is not already overbought. We are avoiding the many names with RSI above 70 so we don't chase stocks that have already run hard.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-on is a market mood where investors feel confident and move money into riskier, faster-growing assets like tech stocks, which is why the NASDAQ beat the S&P 500 today. On days like this it can make sense to put idle cash to work, but you still want to avoid stocks that are already overbought, because they are more likely to pull back.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）是指投資者信心充足，願意把資金轉投風險較高、增長較快的資產，例如科技股，這正是今日納指跑贏標普500的原因。在這類日子適度動用閒置現金入市是合理的，但仍應避開已經超買的股份，因為這些股份短期回調的機會較大。

market_education.summary_en: The market rallied broadly today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ beating the S&P 500 because investors favored growth and AI-linked stocks. Strength in chips and AI infrastructure, including MU, AMD, ARM, MRVL, LITE and DELL, pushed many of them into overbought territory, and crypto miners such as MARA, WULF and CIFR moved up with them. No news headlines came with today's data, so this explanation is based only on price action and technical signals, not on any specific news event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市全面造好，科技股比重較高的納斯達克升幅跑贏標普500，反映資金明顯偏好增長型及AI相關股份。晶片及AI基建板塊領漲，美光、AMD、ARM、Marvell、Lumentum及Dell等多隻股份的RSI已升至超買水平，加密貨幣礦企如MARA、WULF及CIFR亦同步走高。由於今日數據並未附帶新聞標題，以上分析僅根據股價走勢及技術指標，並非源自特定消息。

trades.reasoning: EQPT has a bullish MACD crossover, a rising histogram and is trading above its SMA-20, and its RSI of 57.3 is well short of overbought, so it has more room to run than most of today's extended names and is cheap enough to buy with the remaining $445 in cash.
